Re-check each record against its first-party page: does the egress path still work, and what limit binds it? Record a limits[] row for the binding constraint where the record lacks one.
An audit of the first attempt judged these claims unsupported by their sources; settle each one first:
- egress/alibaba-anti-ddos-proxy $.binding: The page prices clean bandwidth and QPS per mitigation plan and separately gives a count of protected IPs; it does not describe per-IP shaping.
- egress/amazon-web-services-free-tier $.egress.terms: The page states the 100 GB/month aggregated free egress allowance but says nothing about ingress or UDP; the "; ingress: udp" part of the value is missing.
- egress/alibaba-cloud-international $.egress.terms: The page states the 20 GB mainland + 200 GB outside free quota and that inbound traffic is never billed, but says nothing about an ingress protocol or UDP; the "; ingress: udp" part of the value is missing.
- egress/amazon-web-services-free-tier $.identity_cost.kind: The signup page shows Root user email address, AWS account name and Verify email address, with no card field; the identity cost shown is email, not card.
